gaps.description: One T2 original history replay reached the decision but extra diagnostic snapshot changed its fingerprint. Case remains spent; no retry and no inferred geom.
Original CONFIRM40 Teacher dynamic success and signed-clearance distribution were never qualified; static IK/FOV is not dynamic feasibility.
Original process hidden IK/Python/RNG snapshots were not saved. Complete deterministic history and observed-state parity are measured; bitwise unrecorded identity is not.
No same-state qualified T2 expert channel-replacement trial. Static channel projections are not dynamic causal ablations.
Exact offending finger side/position at JOINT_LIMIT not logged; all arm margins are positive, so frozen rule identifies finger-validity branch, not an arm joint violation.
Single candidate/training seed,10 scene groups per task and2 banks. Family confounds geometry, direction and visual appearance; no unique neural cause or broad OOD claim.
Only original sampled20Hz camera/TCP divergence is measured; an event between samples has at most50ms timing resolution. No new render.
No Go2/WBC or real-robot task proof; TF-R3 STOP remains. Source fixed-base outcomes cannot substitute for target transfer.
